title: Computational investigation of the inhibitory interaction of IRF3 and SARS-CoV-2 accessory protein ORF3b.
authors: Bai, Ganggang; Zeng, Xincheng; Zhang, Linghao; Wang, Yanjing; Ma, Buyong
one_liner_zh: 该文用REMD和MD模拟研究SARS-CoV-2 ORF3b蛋白与IRF3的抑制性结合，属于蛋白-蛋白互作而非TF-DNA体系，但分子动力学与对接方法可迁移至蛋白-DNA互作建模，故给予中档分。
abstract: ORF3b is one of the SARS-CoV-2 accessory proteins. Previous experimental study suggested that ORF3b prevents IRF3 translocating to nucleus. However, the biophysical mechanism of ORF3b-IRF3 interaction is elusive. Here, we explored the conformation ensemble of ORF3b using all-atom replica exchange molecular dynamics simulation. Disordered ORF3b has mixed alpha-helix, beta-turn and loop conformers. The potential ORF3b-IRF3 binding modes were searched by docking representative ORF3b conformers with IRF3, and 50 ORF3b-IRF3 complex poses were screened using molecular dynamics simulations ranging from 500 to 1000 ns. We found that ORF3b binds IRF3 predominantly on its CBP binding and phosphorylated pLxIS motifs, with CBP binding site has the highest binding affinity. The ORF3b-IRF3 binding residues are highly conserved in SARS-CoV-2. Our results provided biophysics insights into ORF3b-IRF3 interaction and explained its interferon antagonism mechanism.
abstract_zh: ORF3b是SARS-CoV-2的辅助蛋白之一。先前的实验研究表明，ORF3b阻止IRF3转位至细胞核。然而，ORF3b-IRF3相互作用的生物物理机制尚不明确。在此，我们利用全原子副本交换分子动力学模拟探索了ORF3b的构象集合。无序的ORF3b具有混合的α-螺旋、β-转角和无规卷曲构象。通过将代表性的ORF3b构象与IRF3进行对接，搜索了潜在的ORF3b-IRF3结合模式，并利用500至1000纳秒的分子动力学模拟筛选了50个ORF3b-IRF3复合物姿态。我们发现，ORF3b主要结合IRF3的CBP结合位点和磷酸化的pLxIS基序，其中CBP结合位点具有最高的结合亲和力。ORF3b-IRF3结合残基在SARS-CoV-2中高度保守。我们的结果为ORF3b-IRF3相互作用提供了生物物理见解，并解释了其干扰素拮抗机制。
